sections: Use this guide to run the ClawQL dashboard as a Helm-managed service (not a local dev server), expose it at http://clawql.localhost, and keep signature enforcement aligned with the rest of the stack.
The dashboard is Vault-first and can update Vault keys, then restart clawql-mcp-http so provider env changes are applied consistently.
These values control where dashboard sync reads/writes:

With CLAWQL_OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH (chart: obsidianVaultPath) and the shared obsidian-vault volume mount, the dashboard writes Agent Chat history under Dashboard/chats/ on the same disk as Memory/ and memory.db. Enable OpenClaw + chat bridge (openclaw.enabled, openclaw.chatBridge.enabled) so CLAWQL_DASHBOARD_OPENCLAW_CHAT_URL auto-wires; see OpenClaw + ClawQL and Helm.
Kyverno verifyImages includes dashboard by default via:
If kyverno.imageSignaturePolicy.enabled=true (default), unsigned dashboard images are denied at admission like MCP/website images.
